name: GAMEBoT
description: A gaming arena benchmark designed for rigorous and transparent assessment of LLM reasoning capabilities by decomposing complex reasoning in games into modular subproblems with Chain-of-Thought prompts and rule-based ground truth generation.
reputation: GAMEBoT is a recent benchmark and does not yet appear to have broad community adoption, but it is positioned as a transparent testbed for game-based reasoning in LLMs.
notes: Benchmark includes dynamic games and head-to-head LLM competitions to reduce data contamination.
